system.description:
Write is the companion skill to Read. As I mentioned in the Read listing, it is possible to have this as a separate skill. Without the benefit of the ability to read, Write is a copyist’s skill. The character knows the shapes of letters and how to reproduce them, but he does not know what they mean. A character with Write may transcribe his thoughts onto paper in reasonably coherent chunks.

Obstacles: Your name, Ob 1. Copying letters, Ob 2. Composing a letter, Ob 3.

FoRKs: Composition, Calligraphy

Skill Type: Academic. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 309
